messages:
Leah: Morning — quick async check from sales: pipeline update for HelixHealth pilot. What I did: intro call went well, they want a 4-week dedicated pilot. Blockers: Legal needs NDA signed, Helix is requesting HSM attestation + VPC peering + SOC2 evidence. Also they asked for a billing SKU for pilot pricing. Today: follow up with Legal, share Confluence dataflow, coordinate PR merge for private-deploy KMS flag, schedule demo.
Dmitri: @Leah we can support customer-managed KMS keywrap next week. HSM attestation is trickier — requires vendor attestation paper + possible on-prem test harness. ETA ~2–3w for full attestation depending on vendor turnaround. For VPC peering we need their CIDR ranges and a contact; sent a short template to Leah.
Sana: For SOC2 evidence we can provide the Type II report and an export of audit logs. Legal usually asks for 12mo retention. Also need to map data flows (what leaves our boundary). @Leah can you drop the dataflow diagram or the list of PII fields they care about? :mag_right:
Leah: Shared the diagram in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SELL/pages/Helix-Dataflow (added PII masking notes). Confirmed with them whether HSM-backed keys are mandatory or optional — they said "prefer mandatory" but open to discussion.
Paul: Heads-up: PR #4021 (private-deploy: kms-flag + docs) blocks the demo if not merged. It's a small config toggle and doc update. @Dmitri can you review today? Also need a quick code review ping for the client telemetry opt-out changes.
Dmitri: I'll take PR #4021 this morning. Also pinged @Alex to run an e2e on dedicated infra after merge. If CI is green can cut a canary build for the demo.
Alex: ran a quick smoke on dedicated cluster earlier — found a routing rule mismatch for forwarded subnets, fixed it. E2E test will run after PR merge. ops-oncall, can we book a short maintenance window Fri 09:00–10:00 PT to demo and run the canary?
ops-oncall: maintenance window accepted: Fri 2026-03-20 09:00-10:00 PT. Creating an incident channel and will post a reminder 24h prior. Notifying infra and networking.
security-bot: Note — Helix requested HSM FIPS cert details. Reference doc available: /compliance/hsm-fips-brief.pdf. Attaching to the Confluence page and emailing the contact.
Sana: Adding a security checklist to Confluence (HSM certs, key rotation policy, backup encryption at rest+in-transit, IAM key access). @Dmitri do backups require any special key mapping for customer-managed keys?
Dmitri: Backups default to platform KMS. We can enable CMKs (customer-managed keys) per contract; needs IAM mapping and rotation policy config — roughly 1–2d ops work to set up for a pilot.
Leah: Good to know — I'll relay that. Also need the billing SKU for the 4-week dedicated pilot so procurement can cut a PO. Anyone have the current SKU?
Paul: Sending pricing sheet v3 to the thread. SKU for pilot: RDW-DEDI-PILOT-4W-1GPU. CC @Mara for finance approval.
Mara: Confirmed SKU and provisional discount (15%) for pilot. I'll send the order form today and track NDAs. Legal should have the doc by EOD.
Leah: Thanks everyone — blockers now: NDA signature + PR merge. I'll update Helix and circle back once Legal confirms and PR is merged. Will ping again if anything stalls. :thumbsup:
